authority: synthetic detector-transfer certificate; not a collider forecast or empirical result

detectorFold.resolution: normalized symmetric Gaussian convolution in reconstructed x

factorialTransfer.responseClass: fixed linear detector folding of an amplitude linear in three declared source coefficients remains quadratic in those coefficients

experimentSemantics.simulatedSettings: The 27 signed settings are generator/template evaluations used to identify and validate the response surface.
experimentSemantics.observedWorld: Collider data provide one unknown physical coefficient point, not 27 experimentally reversible source settings.
experimentSemantics.reversalUse: S -> -S is an internal template and implementation diagnostic. It can isolate source-odd response in simulation but is not assumed to be a laboratory control.
experimentSemantics.physicalLeakageControl: Acceptance-odd and background-slope leakage must be constrained with calibrated response, sidebands, control categories and nuisance covariance in the one physical data set.

verdict.closed: For the declared toy amplitude and fixed linear detector, symmetric smearing preserves odd parity and the interference sign while attenuating it. Odd acceptance creates an even-to-odd leakage, but the 19-setting quadratic fit still predicts all eight held-out corners to numerical precision.
verdict.implication: Detector folding does not by itself invalidate AZ-074. It changes the coefficients and can create nuisance odd moments; a fixed response remains inside the quadratic design, while coupling-dependent widths, selections or migrations must be exposed by held-out failures or modeled explicitly.
verdict.open: No source-complete charged-production diphoton helicity amplitude, physical mass window, calibrated response matrix, event covariance or public-data likelihood has been supplied.
verdict.nextCalculation: Choose one physical charged-production diphoton channel; generate the gauge-complete continuum and resonant helicity amplitudes in one frozen EFT basis; derive its response matrix and nuisance covariance; then use the 27 templates to predict held-out simulations before fitting the single observed data set.
